Item Number - 6574
                                     LETTER OF SUPPORT

To:           Public Utility Commission of Texas

From:         Bruce Burnett, Pro Se Intervenor

Date:         September 18,2026

Subject:      Support for Request for Independent Investigation and Forensic Audit

RE:           PUC Docket No. 59475; Item No. 6571

I support Kevin Kennedy and John Burrow's request for an independent technical investigation
and forensic audit of the modeling underlying ERCOT'S 2024 Permian Basin Reliability
Plan.

I'm not asking the Commission to conclude from Item 6571 that ERCOT'S modeling was
incorrect or that the 765kv import paths are unnecessary. An independent investigation will
verify the answers. Item 6571 brings many questions regarding ERCOT's modeling for the
PBRP and the use of the 765Kv Transmission Lines. Did the 2024 Permian Model discover the
need for 765Kv transmission lines or did the desire for 765Kv transmission lines create the
demand and generation assumptions ERCOT put in the PBRP model?

Item 6571 and my letter of support of Item 6571 is not an accusation of wrong-doing by ERCOT,
Texans deserve to have all models and generation capability investigated independently All
aspects of the PBRP and 765Kv issue must be investigated and explored before Eminent
Domain is unleashed by the Applicants on Texas Landowners and Billions of Dollars worth of
Transmission Lines are billed to the Texas Ratepayer.

I sincerely ask the Commission to consider the request of Item no. 6571 and order an
independent technical review to provide the answers to all questions pertaining to the 765Kv
Import Paths, especially the need for the Bell County East to Big Hill 765Kv project(docket
59475).

Respectfully Submitted,

Bruce Burnett
Pro Se Intervenor
PUC Docket No. 59475
